statement: On wireless input-device creation xpad replaces the receiver's USB product ID in the Linux input identity with 0x02a1. The driver allocates a global xpad LED class index, uses it to choose a player-light pattern and frees it at detach; it is not a persisted paired-controller identifier or an application player-slot ID.
